tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Returns the facts published on this website, in Japanese: service overview, plans, prices and payment terms, how the scanner behaves, how to contact us, and the operating company. Each fact comes with the URL of the page that shows it. Read-only; it returns nothing that is not on the pages.
